_doc: Numbers for the combat HUD, read by scripts/combat/intent.gd and scripts/ui/schematic.gd. INTENT (enemy intent on your schematic): a red reticle sits on the part of your ship the enemy pilot aims at, and every enemy weapon that is heavy and ready within warn_s seconds gets a row ('Artemis in 1.2 s', red under red_under_s). A weapon is HEAVY when its damage is at least heavy_damage (a turret's damage is already scaled down), its shot kind is one of heavy_kinds, or its damage type is one of heavy_damage_types. A heavy weapon only gets a row if its cooldown is at least min_cooldown seconds (2 x warn_s): a warning has to mean 'a big shot is coming, react now', and a gun that fires faster than that is noise whatever its damage. A new target is shown only after the old one has been up for hold_s seconds (a target that is gone switches at once), so the reticle does not flicker. At most max_rows rows are drawn, then '+N more'. family_names: how the reticle's line names the family of the part ('Targeting: Weapons'; a family not listed is capitalised).
